name: Angelcore
reacts_against: nothing specific; a soft, devotional, pale-and-gold mood built from religious-art imagery stripped of its original context.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Angels, cherubs, wings, halos, doves, soft clouds, sunbeams, glitter
wiki_facts.key_colours: White, gold, light blue, light yellow, pastel pink
wiki_facts.key_values: Beauty, benevolence, tranquility, unearthliness, purity, gentleness

findings: mostly muted — about 80% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
